articles.title: Supreme Court Rejects Missouri's New Congressional Map
articles.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court blocked a Republican-drawn map in Missouri, meaning the old districts will be used in November's midterms. The fight could decide which party controls the House of Representatives.

articles.title: Trump Vows $5,000 Payments If GOP Holds Congress
articles.summary: President Trump promised a $5,000 dividend to every adult citizen if Republicans keep Congress. He gave no details on funding, and experts estimate it could cost $1 trillion or more.

articles.title: Oil Surges Past $105 as Middle East Conflict Escalates
articles.summary: Oil prices jumped to $105 a barrel as US-Iran fighting closed the Strait of Hormuz. Gas and borrowing costs are also rising, fueling fears of higher inflation worldwide.
